acceptance: A detached child exceeding a positive wall-clock budget is deterministically terminated through its owned process group, including bounded grace escalation when required.
Detached completion evidence records that the stop was budget-caused and includes bounded elapsed-stop and wall-clock facts.
A child that ignores termination or could otherwise finish later cannot be reported as a normal successful completion after the deadline.
No automatic retry, task-record mutation by the launcher, budget reallocation, or new recovery authority is introduced.

Existing launcher and bounded-process watchdog documentation and focused provider-free tests map to the acceptance, while the unrelated durable-record supervisor assertion remains explicitly separated.
Only the exact detached-watchdog backlog identity is reconciled; neighboring items remain unchanged.
